editorial: Imagine your wedding day turning into a nightmarish waltz beneath the veil of death. With its hand‑drawn murals set against the crumbling glamour of a 19th-century underworld, the film marries haunting lullabies and kinetic theatre. The most striking moment is when the living world blurs with dust‑soaked streets, leaving you clutching both a bouquet of wilted roses and a cursed wedding ring. It will captivate you if you crave gothic romance blended with the visceral delight of a hidden, fairy‑tale world.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of gothic romance in a stop‑motion setting
